name: Redfin
description: Redfin is a residential real-estate brokerage and marketplace for finding homes, rentals, agents, valuations, and housing-market information. Buyers, sellers, renters, and researchers use its website, mobile apps, brokerage services, and Data Center.
agentUseSummary: Redfin cannot currently be connected through Relay. Redfin does not publish a distributable customer-account API or delegated OAuth contract, and its current terms prohibit automated crawling or querying without prior express written permission. Public Data Center and bounded user-initiated listing downloads are separate manual data products, not authority to automate Redfin accounts or property data.

blocked.label: Connect a Redfin account
blocked.description: Redfin does not publish a supported third-party customer-account API, OAuth application contract, token lifecycle, scopes, or revocation interface for Relay to implement.

blocked.label: Read Redfin property or account data
blocked.description: Homes, listings, saved searches, favorites, tours, messages, offers, valuations, agent relationships, rentals, and private account data are unavailable to Relay.

blocked.label: Perform Redfin brokerage actions
blocked.description: Scheduling tours, contacting agents, submitting offers, listing or changing homes, managing rentals, sending messages, and other brokerage or transaction actions are blocked.

blocked.label: Automate Redfin services
blocked.description: Automated crawling, querying, scraping, browser automation, private APIs, cookie or credential capture, bulk extraction, and redistribution are blocked without an exact supported contract and prior express written permission.

blocked.label: Automate Redfin downloads
blocked.description: Data Center CSVs and bounded listing downloads remain user-initiated products; Relay does not infer a stable automation API, bypass regional MLS restrictions, or republish downloaded data.

approvalProfiles.label: Unavailable
approvalProfiles.description: No Redfin action is enabled without a documented distributable API contract, exact data-source permissions, prior written automation approval, and acceptance for the intended fields, geography, audience, retention, display, attribution, and downstream use.

runtimeSupport.description: No supported Redfin API contract is available to mount as OpenClaw tools.
No supported Redfin API contract is available to mount as Hermes tools.

providerSetup.blocker: Redfin publishes consumer and brokerage services plus manual housing-market and listing downloads, but no distributable customer-account API, delegated OAuth contract, scopes, token lifecycle, webhooks, or supported agent runtime. Redfin's current terms prohibit automated crawling or querying without prior express written permission, restrict reproduction and redistribution, and make listing downloads dependent on local MLS rules.
providerSetup.nextAction: Do not request Redfin credentials or show Connect. Reconsider only if Redfin publishes a distributable API/OAuth contract or grants Relay prior express written permission for one bounded product and exact use. Product, legal, data-governance, fair-housing, privacy, and security owners must then freeze the permitted fields, source and MLS rights, geography, user, attribution, display, freshness, retention, redistribution, rate, audit, deletion, and termination rules before implementation.

evidence.supports: Redfin grants only limited personal use, prohibits automated crawling or querying without prior express written permission, and restricts reproduction and redistribution of its services and information.
Redfin documents user-initiated listing downloads with a 350-home cap and availability controlled by local MLS compliance rules, not an application API.
Redfin's Data Center offers filtered CSV downloads for aggregate housing-market metrics and describes each row as one region and time period.
Redfin publishes metric definitions, methodology, and a data release schedule and directs research-collaboration questions to its economics data team.
Redfin's privacy notice governs personal information and account-related data across its consumer and brokerage services.
